title: Government may allow fees on UPI payment above Rs 2,000
content: The government may allow a small charge on UPI payments exceeding two thousand rupees. This levy would apply to transactions made to businesses and not individuals.  Official estimates suggest this change will impact only five percent of all UPI transactions.  Most daily purchases like groceries and taxi fares will remain unaffected by this potential fee.  Industry experts anticipate a possible ceiling on the absolute amount charged for these transactions.

title: 2 ISI-backed terror modules busted: Pistols, petrol bombs seized, 9 arrested
content: Punjab Police apprehended nine individuals, including four juveniles, in two ISI-backed terror modules.  Authorities recovered illegal firearms, petrol bombs, and a stolen motorcycle from the arrested suspects.  The accused were reportedly recruiting local youth for terror activities and conducting surveillance.  These individuals acted at the behest of handlers from the Inter-Services Intelligence agency.  The police operation successfully dismantled these cross-border terror networks.

title: 'You told Sooryavanshi to serve water': Ex-India star questions his debut timing
content: Sooryavanshi earned his maiden India call-up after an outstanding IPL 2026 season. He was picked for the tours of Ireland and England but did not get a game in Ireland. After Sanju Samson struggled with the bat, the team management handed Sooryavanshi his debut in England. However, the teenager had a difficult start, scoring 14, 13 and 15 in the three T20Is he played before being left out of the fifth and final match.

title: Man arrested with gun near Trump's California golf course ahead of fundraiser
content: A man was arrested near President Trump's golf course while allegedly monitoring security preparations. Authorities found a loaded pistol and ammunition in his vehicle and home. He faces multiple felony charges, including robbery and weapons offenses. The suspect pleaded not guilty and was ordered to stay away from the venue. This arrest occurred over a year after a previous assassination attempt conviction.

title: Priscilla Chan founded a school in 2016; 10 yrs later, it closed after $125m funding
content: The Primary School, a tuition-free institution, will close in June after a decade of operation. This school provided education, healthcare, and family support to low-income children. The Chan Zuckerberg Initiative will not continue funding beyond the upcoming academic year. Academic results remained below state averages, prompting the board's decision. The initiative pledged fifty million dollars to aid the transition for affected students.

title: From launch to data, tech to Isro facility, pvt firms to get 30-100% subsidy
content: New government schemes will offer significant financial support to Indian private space companies. These initiatives aim to boost domestic launch capabilities and global competitiveness for businesses. Subsidies will cover launch services, technology transfer, and access to ISRO facilities. The programs are designed to lower entry barriers and accelerate private sector growth. This support will make satellite data and infrastructure more affordable for Indian entities.

title: Father quit job, pawned jewellery to fund chess dream: Olympiad-bound Savitha's story
content: Savitha Shri Baskar never set out to become the family’s chess star. She first picked up the game by watching her elder brother, but soon became the one her father chose to back. He quit his job in Singapore, pawned jewellery and stretched the family’s finances to keep her career going. Now, at 19, Savitha is headed to the Olympiad.

title: OpenAI's Greg Brockman gives millions to save eagles Jackie and Shadow's home
content: Greg Brockman and his wife Anna donated five point five million dollars to save shoreline forest.  This significant contribution helped secure ten million dollars for land conservation efforts.  The land, which is home to rare species, will now be protected from development.  Over twenty-five thousand small donors also contributed to the successful fundraising campaign.  Meanwhile, the eagle matriarch Jackie faces an uncertain health prognosis.

title: Day 12 of Jharkhand students' protest: Hemant Soren breaks silence on exam row
content: In response to mounting allegations of irregularities in recruitment exams, Jharkhand Chief Minister Hemant Soren reassured students of a fair resolution under the law. He emphasized that investigations into reported paper leaks are already in progress by government agencies. Meanwhile, students persist in their protests, calling for exam cancellations and significant reforms. A final decision from the government will follow the completion of these investigations.

title: Priscilla Chan shuts $125M school for disadvantaged to focus on AI
content: The Primary School, offering tuition-free education to low-income families, has officially closed, impacting around 540 children who depended on its support. The Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, the school's benefactor, is redirecting its resources towards biotechnology and artificial intelligence. As part of its commitment, it has announced substantial funding aimed at assisting affected students and local organizations.

title: Meet Roy Kim, 13, who turns air moisture into water for farms
content: In a remarkable feat of ingenuity, a young student has created technology that converts air moisture into potable water. This device stands as a sustainable beacon for farmers struggling with inadequate water supply. Featuring a Peltier module for condensation, it smartly monitors water delivery and environmental factors through advanced sensors. Roy Kim aspires for his invention to play a significant role in alleviating the global water challenges faced by agriculture.

title: American investor Michael Burry, who warned of 2008 crisis, sees a 'bloody mess'
content: Michael Burry warns of market carnage from automated trading funds.  He sees rapid unwinds potentially unleashing significant market disruption.  Volatility levels are climbing to their highest in nearly a century.  Burry also criticizes large AI deals and their funding structures.  These complex arrangements could expose investors to substantial future risks.

title: Oil price today: Crude steadies below $80 as Hormuz blockade keeps investors on edge
content: Oil prices nudged higher on Wednesday after a series of declines, as investors keep a keen eye on the diplomatic maneuvers surrounding the US-Iran standoff. Progress is reportedly being made by negotiators striving to bring an end to the conflict and restore access to the Strait of Hormuz. While US crude and gasoline inventories increased last week, there was a drop in distillate stocks.

title: Day after PK's poll win, PM Modi talks to Nabin, meets Nitish
content: During a recent NDA meeting, government officials emphasized the importance of economic growth and the creation of jobs. The event also saw discussions surrounding India's evolving sports landscape. Prime Minister Modi and Amit Shah were present, and a humorous exchange between Modi and Nitin Nabin generated buzz among the MPs. Subsequently, Modi held discussions with former Bihar CM Nitish Kumar and his JDU associates.

title: West Bengal to fast-track land acquisition to take trains close to Doklam
content: West Bengal government has approved land acquisition for a new railway line. This project aims to improve connectivity to the India-China-Bhutan tri-junction area. The new rail link will boost tourism in the Jhaldhaka-Bindu-Todey Tangta region. Railways and the forest department will conduct a joint survey after the monsoon. This strategically important project was previously stalled due to state government non-cooperation.

title: 'I want to be a coach': Ben Stokes eyes England coaching role after retirement
content: Ben Stokes retired from international cricket in June during England's Test series against New Zealand. The 35-year-old had an outstanding career, playing a key role in England's 2019 ODI World Cup triumph and producing his unforgettable match-winning innings in the Ashes Test at Headingley later that year.

title: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' Day 6: Tom Holland's movie crosses Rs 360 cr in India
content: Spider-Man: Brand New Day continues its strong box office run in India. The film has already crossed three hundred crore rupees in net collections. Its gross collections are nearing four hundred crore rupees within the first week. The Hindi dubbed version shows exceptional performance with high occupancy rates. This blockbuster is on track to become Hollywood's highest-grossing film in India.

title: Over 30 operatives killed by 'Indian agents' since 2020: LeT commander
content: Rizwan Hanif, a commander affiliated with Lashkar-e-Taiba, has alleged that Indian agents have systematically killed more than thirty individuals in different Pakistani locations since 2020. He characterized these murders as acts of religious persecution and rejected the authority of foreign entities. This statement comes amid heightened rhetoric from Pakistan's military, and experts suggest it serves as a strategic narrative amidst rising tensions.

title: 'You drop me': Ex-cricketer says Rohit Sharma has thrown the ball into selectors' court
content: Mohammed Kaif believes Rohit Sharma will not retire from ODIs voluntarily. He suggests the selectors will make the final decision on his career. Sharma's recent century at Lord's indicates his continued focus on playing. Kaif also highlighted the need for clear communication from team management. The BCCI's timely statement prevented unnecessary speculation surrounding the match.

title: Pakistan boxer Qudratullah ‘goes missing’ in Glasgow after CWG campaign
content: Pakistani boxer Qudratullah reportedly went missing in Glasgow hours before the national team’s departure, with his passport and return ticket remaining with the team manager. Pakistan finished the Commonwealth Games with just one medal, a bronze for Fatima Zahra. Her historic achievement made her the first Pakistani female boxer to win a CWG medal, while Arshad Nadeem missed out.

title: Cristiano Ronaldo’s journey from poverty to football greatness
content: Cristiano Ronaldo’s journey is about much more than football. From growing up in poverty and leaving home at 12 to losing his father before achieving global success, every challenge shaped the player he became. His story reminds people that discipline, sacrifice and love for family can help overcome even the hardest moments and turn dreams into reality.

title: Top 5 greatest UFC lightweight champions of all time ranked
content: Khabib Nurmagomedov leads the list of greatest UFC lightweight champions. Islam Makhachev continues the Dagestani tradition of excellence with his dominant reign. Charles Oliveira transformed into a dangerous finisher after a remarkable comeback story. Justin Gaethje earned his place with a fearless fighting style and exciting battles. B.J. Penn, a Hall of Famer, pioneered the division's growth.

title: 6-year-old with heart condition scores dream Panthers touchdown
content: Six-year-old Asher Harvey, who was born with a complex heart condition and has undergone multiple heart surgeries, fulfilled his dream of becoming a Carolina Panthers player for a day through Make-A-Wish. He signed a one-day contract, met quarterback Bryce Young, joined team activities and scored a touchdown during Fan Fest, giving his family a joyful milestone after years of medical challenges.

title: 'Jana Nayagan' box office collection: Vijay film drops 45.5%, crosses Rs 300 cr worldwide
content: Jana Nayagan has achieved a significant box office milestone, crossing Rs 300 crore worldwide. The action drama completed thirteen days in theatres, earning Rs 2.10 crore on its latest day. India net collections reached Rs 181.55 crore, while overseas markets added Rs 92 crore. The film's worldwide gross collection now stands at Rs 303.74 crore. This success follows a strong first week of Rs 153.55 crore in India net.

title: Government to grill Meta brass on child abuse, AI content
content: In an important meeting scheduled for this week, government officials will confront Meta executives regarding pressing issues. The discussions will center around the presence of child sexual abuse material, the rise of AI-created content, and the measures in place for takedowns involving notable personalities. Compliance with local laws and the efficiency of Meta's content moderation efforts, particularly in monitoring synthetic content, are also poised to be key topics of concern.

title: Cyber crime reports down from 1.2L in 2024 to 16,377 now: Government
content: Supreme Court urged prompt action against cyber fraudsters, while noting a reduction in incidents.  Authorities were directed to expedite decisions on a 'kill switch' for phones.  Monies transferred to mule accounts will be placed on hold by banks.  Victims will receive recovered amounts expeditiously after investigations conclude.  New directives aim to enhance cyber crime grievance redressal mechanisms.

title: Computer-based NEET? Govt tells SC decision after Nilekani report
content: The government informed the Supreme Court about considering NEET's shift to computer-based testing. This decision awaits the Nandan Nilekani task force's report on public examination systems. Measures are being taken to make the exam more secure and prevent unfair means. The National Testing Agency has already moved seven major exams to computer-based formats. NEET (UG) currently remains the only major pen-and-paper examination conducted by the NTA.

title: WA tests optional age verification pilot, says user privacy will be protected
content: To comply with the upcoming Digital Personal Data Protection Act, WhatsApp is piloting new privacy-focused age verification methods for Indian users. This initiative is completely voluntary, allowing users to choose their participation. With the new law's emphasis on stricter regulations for children's personal data, WhatsApp is taking care to safeguard user privacy during this important verification process.

title: 274 fugitives brought back from 36 nations since 2019
content: Government brought back 274 fugitives from 36 countries since 2019. Assets worth over Rs 17,874 crore were attached during this period. This contrasts with the UPA government's record of fewer extraditions annually. Legal frameworks were updated, and diplomatic efforts intensified for fugitive recovery. This approach reflects a coordinated "whole of government" strategy for justice.

title: '100% pure'? Stop misleading products' sale, FSSAI tells Dabur
content: Dabur India has been instructed by the FSSAI to halt the sale of items claiming to be '100% pure.' This decision stems from a violation of food regulations deemed misleading to consumers. The FSSAI identified unauthorized organic claims on various products. Despite Dabur's assertion that its labels meet regulatory standards, the company will eliminate '100%' references from its marketing efforts.

title: Census phase 2 likely to accept half-filled forms
content: Census authorities are considering allowing partially filled online forms for self-enumeration. This change aims to ease the process for respondents and enumerators alike. Previously, blank fields prevented form submission, discouraging self-enumeration. The population enumeration exercise is scheduled nationwide for February 2027. Select snow-bound regions will conduct enumeration earlier, from September 1 to 30.

title: 'No double meaning in my speech; TN CM using diversion tactic,' says Udhayanidhi
content: Udhayanidhi Stalin faced arrest over alleged remarks linked to actor Trisha. The Madras High Court directed his release on station bail after questioning. DMK workers staged protests across Tamil Nadu following the arrest. The TVK government and opposition engaged in a war of words. Udhayanidhi denied allegations and stated his remarks were distorted.

title: EU eyes tougher border controls after Ceuta migrant surge triggers alarm
content: European Union ministers are demanding stricter measures against migrant smuggling networks.  They also seek stronger return policies following a large influx into Ceuta.  The bloc is enhancing border security and intelligence sharing with external partners.  Disinformation by smugglers fueled the unprecedented migration surge into the Spanish enclave.  This crisis has reignited divisions within the European Union over migration management.

title: After opening golf tournament, CM Omar says authorities must not allow repeat of migrant worker killings
content: Omar Abdullah, the chief minister of Jammu and Kashmir, strongly condemned the recent violence against migrant laborers, emphasizing that such acts are unacceptable and calling for heightened security measures. He also underscored the significance of golf tournaments as a means to boost tourism in the area, recalling a time when these events were a hallmark of Kashmir's serene landscape, well before militancy took root.

title: Veteran actor Pradeep Rawat of 'Ghajini', 'Lagaan' fame passes away after battle with cancer
content: Renowned veteran actor Pradeep Rawat, celebrated for his iconic villain roles, has passed away at the age of seventy-four. His death occurred on the evening of August 4, 2026, as announced by his Lagaan co-star Yashpal Sharma. Rawat's remarkable contributions in both Hindi and South Indian cinema were matched only by his genuine humility and strong on-screen presence. He leaves behind a lasting legacy.

title: Tie compensation to functional disability, says SC
content: the doctor certified her 90% disabled, but a bench held that she was suffering from 100% functional disability . a minor who met with an accident when she was just six months old is now suffering from severe spinal cord and neurological injuries . the bench said it would be reasonable to assume that functional incapacity resulting from a particular bodily injury may be higher and greater than what may be medically perceived .
